```sql
SELECT sa.sku, sa.shelf_status, COUNT(*) AS audit_count
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.products p ON sa.sku = p.sku
WHERE sa.audit_timestamp >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND sa.audit_timestamp < DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND p.pack_size = '5 kg' AND p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%'
GROUP BY sa.sku, sa.shelf_status;
```

```sql

FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.products p ON sa.sku = p.sku
WHERE sa.audit_timestamp >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND sa.audit_timestamp < DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND p.pack_size = '5 kg' AND p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%'
ORDER BY sa.audit_timestamp;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sa.shelf_status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sa.shelf_status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS availability_pct
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.products p ON sa.sku = p.sku
WHERE sa.audit_timestamp >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND sa.audit_timestamp < DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND p.pack_size = '5 kg' AND p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%';
```
